evidence: A satisfying settlement can select Illinois state court in Cook County, use a customer-list database-only scope, leave carrier consent unobtained, and commit Owen to obtain and document written consent before filing, Nadia to update the evidence chart, and Thomas to record the exclusive forum clause, with PF1, PF2, and PF3 justified and PF2 revealed. A settlement retaining the broad scope or unspecified forum would plausibly fail C2 or C3.
